title: Ideology as a Problem: Lightweight Logit Steering for Annotator-Specific Alignment in Social Media Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on political ideology alignment (Left, Center, Right) and bias mitigation in LLMs. While it includes 'Church-State' as one of twelve political facets, the core research is about political stance detection and logit-level steering rather than a dedicated evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethical systems.
